body:
Migrate the complete exact-math result identity operation in math_evaluation::prepare to native PurRDF JSON. Both the standalone and caller-context branches belong to this unit; finance_evaluation is the actual contextual caller. Principles 4 and 7.

Blocks: #1776. The required complete native AST and RDF literal writers are already merged; no open semantic prerequisite blocks this operation.

Scope and acceptance:

- Preserve the exact compact five-field and eight-field preimages, tuple order, ordered bindings, full Formula/Term and RDF literal metadata, context identity, context premises and quantity-class set. Preserve the existing rule that any nonempty context field selects the complete contextual tuple.
- Retain SHA-256, the complete result quantity and program-source identities, public APIs, arithmetic lowering, proof construction and financial result behavior. Reuse the complete native nested owners. Do not introduce a generic tuple framework or a second AST representation.
- Capture complete original preimages and actual result identities before replacing the encoder. Extend the existing math identity case, retaining every existing binding, statement-order, AST and lexical-value assertion. Cover standalone, individually nonempty context fields and a complete context. Replay frozen original bytes through the actual native encoder and verify the actual production result identities.
- Reuse the existing authored finance_evaluation_derives_money_and_return_with_owned_quantity_typing_proof control for the contextual production caller. No new test case or generic JSON compliance suite.
- Qualify actual logic, pipeline and developer CLI consumers with warnings denied, both selected behavioral controls, independent source review, helper hygiene, static producer recipe and normal signed hooks. Include readiness, qualification and landing in the original eight-hour delivery clock.

This is a complete child operation under the native JSON parent; it does not retire the parent's other records, streaming commitments or authenticated consumers. No local optimized producer, canonical corpus or fixture construction, sync or full gate. Controls use only independently authored data and native execution. CI remains explicitly waived rather than passing. Installed/embedded CLI, browser, corpus and release acceptance remain open. No performance gain is claimed without a measurement.
